description: Source code for UCI binding for switch configuration utility, including functions for applying configurations from UCI packages, managing switch settings, and mapping configurations to switch attributes.

methods.name: swlib_match_name
methods.description: Checks if the given name matches the device's name or alias.

methods.name: swlib_map_settings
methods.description: Maps UCI section options to switch attributes based on device, type, and VLAN/port.

methods.name: swlib_apply_from_uci
methods.description: Main function to apply UCI package configurations to a switch device.
